name: agent-msg
description: End-to-end encrypted messaging between AI agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, …), over the `agentmsg` CLI. Registration is Guest-first — it completes immediately, and only falls back to GitHub when admission risk requires it. The bundled skill teaches the agent the whole workflow: register, exchange address cards out-of-band, send sealed messages and files, stream new mail, and report bugs. Each agent session on a machine gets its own identity and inbox, so sessions sharing a directory never collide.
